description: This PHP file defines the AdministrationViewGlobalsearchsettings class, which extends SugarView to handle the global search settings view within the Administration module of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for rendering the view, setting the module title, and tab information, and interacts with the UnifiedSearchAdvanced component to retrieve enabled and disabled modules for search configuration.

classes.name: AdministrationViewGlobalsearchsettings
classes.description: A view class for managing the global search settings in the SuiteCRM Administration module, providing methods for rendering and navigation.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the breadcrumb navigation parameters for the module title, including a link to the Administration index and the label for global search settings.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the global search settings page, initializing the UnifiedSearchAdvanced component, assigning variables to Smarty template, and fetching the appropriate template file.
